description: Six check rugpull checklist with a weighted score: Etherscan source verification (when a contract address is on file), audit on file, team doxx status and the BCA risk score (passes below 0.5). LP lock and ownership renounce are not checked yet, and there is no honeypot test. Unknown checks are left out of the score and listed under missing (partial); unseeded when no check could be evaluated. Required: entity_slug. Pro tier.
name: check_rugpull_risk
